title: デビュー戦の後に・意外な弱点

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross crosses the finish line of her debut without issue. After the race, however…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Urgh… The heck? My legs're shakin'…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, junior-level races shouldn't take this much outta me… Why do I feel so… woozy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her to rest a little before we reflect on today's events and formulate plans for the future.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I-it's not that big of a deal. Just a li'l tired, that's all.
choice_data_list: Are you sure it wasn't because you didn't eat enough?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that could be the case…
choice_data_list: Why would you starve yourself before a big race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well… I didn't think this was worth bringin' up, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't have that much of an appetite. Been that way since I was a kid…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, squirts! You two're still starvin', right? Here, have my share.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Brother
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: But… aren't you hungry too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'm stuffed. The next door neighbor got me some beef udon earlier.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So eat up, will ya? If ya don't, ya won't grow up big 'n strong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …I always made sure the li'l squirts ate first, so my stomach ended up shrinkin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guess I just got used to it. Now I even feel like I focus better on a light stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I'm not sure it's somethin' I can change overnight. Trust me, too much food spells trouble for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …From the sounds of it, she's probably tried to increase her food intake in the past to no avail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if we don't work on these ingrained eating habits, there's no way we'll be able to build her up to be more athletic.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Don't worry 'bout it. I might not be a foodie, but my guts are straight outta Naniwa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And the next place I wanna take these guts is a G1! How 'bout we try the Hopeful Stakes or somethin'? I gotta hurry up 'n show the folks back home how far I've come!
choice_data_list: That's a fine aspiration, but I'm not sure we should make it our goal…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why da heck not?! I know I can pull it off! Geez, talk about a party pooper!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, now's the time to make a push. Don't overthink it. Just go with the flow!
choice_data_list: Why don't we plan for the future and prioritize building up your body?
Why don't we plan for the future and prioritize building up your body?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna do all that slow 'n steady crap! I'm good to go!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter how bulky the other runners are, I'll send 'em flyin' 'n make my family proud! I'm not the same racer I was before my debut!
choice_data_list: In that case, how about we try a little test tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A test, huh? Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buonooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aarrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross makes her grand sumo wrestling debut, but it's not long before she's knocked out of the ring by the towering yokozuna, Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's all it took to send me flying?!
choice_data_list: Now do you see why building muscle is important?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Tch, so the big leagues are full of jumbo runners like her? If that's the case, hoo boy…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right. I get it. We can stick to the low-level races for now while I bulk up. But how long's that gonna take?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's a good question. Even if we start bulking up right away, we won't see results overnight. We'll need to set a tentative end date…
choice_data_list: We'll stick with this until next spring. That'll bring us right up to the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's ages away! C'mon, let's just go straight to the G1!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buoooono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Fiiine! Next spring it is. That gives me till then to chow down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide to build up our racing experience slowly but surely between now and next spring.
